measurementNotes.playwright: Unavailable on macOS 12 — browser E2E from prior session; API-level scripts used for mutations and route bundles
measurementNotes.perfTrace: Env-gated PERF_TRACE=1 backend, NEXT_PUBLIC_PERF_TRACE=1 frontend — retained for dev observability

confirmed: Product form openCreate blocked on fetchNextProductSku GET before showing form
Customer create/update/delete awaited full 200-row reload blocking submit return
inventoryStockController cleared caches synchronously before response
Employee create navigated to list without cache patch causing full refetch
Redis REDIS_URL not set — backend uses in-memory cache fallback (working)
authUserCache reduces auth Mongo from ~348ms to ~1ms on warm requests
Product POST API faster than Customer POST at Mongo layer (variable Atlas latency on customer writes)
Route-aware hydration verified: Users/Admin routes fetch 0 list modules
suspected: Mongo list queries on Atlas replica set routinely 350–1000ms without Redis
Sales Order form may duplicate customer/product/employee lookups when hydrator + form both mount
Customer Mongo write variance (508–1183ms) may include index/duplicate-key retry on first insert

product.mainBottleneck: Form open SKU fetch (fixed lazy); notifyApiMutation listeners minimal

employee.mainBottleneck: List refetch on return (fixed cache patch)
